scope: Add a durable server-side PEI admission credential bound to normalized wallet, UTC challenge day, verification digest and expiry.
Require and bind the credential during Daily reservation only when PEI_ENABLED=true, then consume it atomically with the existing started-attempt transition.
Preserve the accepted V10 R5 Daily and wallet-free Practice behavior while PEI remains disabled by default.
non_goals: No helper Mini App, PEI request/proof/carrier schema, chain lookup, receipt ablation, public PEI journey, mainnet transaction or payout-mode change.
planned_checks: Focused PEI admission, reward and protocol checks
deterministic_seeds: Fixed admission IDs, credential tokens, verification digests, UTC instants and V10 reward seeds in focused tests
